title: Apply imported application settings

request.text: установи такие настройки в этой ветке

decision: Promote all compatible values from the supplied Toolcraft settings JSON v3 to canonical source defaults for codex/iceberg-experiments; ignore source-version-only keys and retain the new Plate gap default at zero.
risks: The supplied payload does not contain iceberg.plateGap, so its branch default remains zero.
iceberg.carveAmount and iceberg.carveHeight do not exist in this branch and are intentionally omitted.
